notes: 'he measured' has no written connective, so the first wayyiqtol waw is unrepresented and the verse's single 'and' goes to the second (rule 42's counting applied to connectives).
בָּאַמָּה is left with nothing: the ASV writes 'a thousand cubits' bare, so the preposition and its assimilated article are unrepresented under rules 40 and 29 while the noun takes 'cubits'.
